features.quote: Workshops throughout the morning and afternoon
features.rationale: The program lists workshops on each day of the event.

features.quote: Access to all workshops, Shows and parties
features.rationale: The full pass grants access to shows, so shows are part of the event.
The program lists daytime socials on Saturday and Sunday.
The program names a Latino Room in addition to the Kizomba Room, so there is more than one dance room.

features.quote: CENTRAL HOTEL – SAN CRISTÓBAL SCHOOL HOTEL
features.rationale: The description gives a recommended hotel with negotiated per-person room rates, and the accommodation is not part of the pass.

features.quote: A FULL PASS is required to stay at the host hotel.
features.rationale: Dancers stay at the host hotel, which is the same school venue where the event takes place.
